title: A density-one point is a regular point (support form of Simon 5.7.1)
statement: Assume AllardRegularityTheorem (Simon 5.2, the sibling node). Let n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open, V a rectifiable n-varifold in U with generalized mean curvature H, H locally in Lᵖ(μ_V) with p > n, θ ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e., x₀ ∈ U and Θⁿ(μ_V, x₀) = 1. Then x₀ ∈ reg V, i.e. x₀ ∈ spt V and B̆_ρ(x₀) ∩ spt V is an n-dimensional C¹ submanifold for some ρ > 0.
lean_statement: AllardRegularityTheorem → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, 1 ≤ V.mult x) → ∀ x₀ ∈ U, V.HasDensity x₀ 1 → x₀ ∈ V.regularSet
